remote.description: Only adopt remote records observed through this named peer.

CoverageConfig.description:
`[coverage]`

A claim whose range, or a reference whose selection, takes more than `broad_share` of a
file's non-blank lines is *broad*: one claim backing a whole document, or one reference
using a whole document, raises coverage without saying which part supports what. Broad
claims and references are reported, and coverage is also given without them (`narrow`).

broad_min_lines.description:
Files with fewer non-blank lines are never broad (selecting all of a short file is
precise). Defaults to `40`.

broad_share.description:
Share (0.0–1.0) of a file's non-blank lines above which a range is broad. Defaults to
`0.5`.

DaemonConfig.description: TCP write policy. The listener is read-only by default.

peer_bytes.description: Maximum cumulative bytes accepted from one IP address (default: 4 GiB).

push_bytes.description: Maximum bytes accepted per push (default: 256 MiB).

receive.description: Enable incoming pushes for the addresses in `write`.

write.description: Per-branch IP addresses or CIDRs. `*` is the fallback.

ignore.description: Additional gitignore-style patterns of paths to skip when looking for evidence files.

jobs.description: Maximum number of pairs updated in parallel. Defaults to the number of CPUs.

timeout.description: Default timeout of a single command (e.g. `10m`).

auto.description: Verify and collect eligible objects periodically after updates.

url.description: A project-relative path, absolute path, or `tcp://HOST[:PORT]`.

encryption.description: Encrypt newly written snapshots and managed metadata. Defaults to `true`.

path.description:
Object store directory. Relative paths are resolved against the project root.
Defaults to `.evidence/objects`.

description: Configuration of the `evidence` command (global, project, or project-local layer).

coverage.description: Coverage: when a claim or a reference is too broad to count as precise evidence.
